## Product status
AI Brain is in development. There is no public SDK, package or API yet. Packages on PyPI or npm named "aibrain", "aibrain-sdk" or "@aibrain/sdk" are NOT affiliated with AI Brain. Developers can join the waitlist at https://aibrainstartup.com/#waitlist.

## What is being built
- A persistent memory layer for LLM applications and agents, combining vector embeddings with a knowledge graph so context can be recalled across sessions.
- Multi-hop (associative) recall across linked memories: conversations, ideas, projects and entities.
- Specialised agents (research, coding, strategy, knowledge, automation) that share one memory graph.
- Planned infrastructure on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Vertex AI, GKE, Cloud Storage).

## Design targets (not yet benchmarked)
- Recall latency target: under 15 ms (p99)
- Redundant-token reduction target: ~91% versus re-sending full context
These are engineering goals, not published results.
